purpose.summary: This program is a billing/receipt confirmation screen handler (S03N) for the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt software system. It manages patient billing data including insurance fees, co-payments, and payment collection records. It handles screen navigation, data entry, and payment registration for the Japanese medical billing subsystem.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses MCP (Message Control Program) middleware instead, typical of ORCA system
Japanese-language comments encoded in latin-1 (actually Shift-JIS or EUC-JP, mojibake visible)
COPY statements referencing many domain-specific copybooks (CPSYUNOU, CPSRYACT, CPSRYACCT, CPPTINF, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA — screen-based online program
OCCURS clauses for insurance fee arrays (up to 12 entries), payment history tables
EVALUATE with ALSO for multi-condition dispatch on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT
Signed PIC S9 fields for adjustment amounts
Version history comments with revision tracking (01.01.01, 01.01.04, etc.)
27 CALL statements, 88 PERFORMs, 22 GOTOs — substantial procedural complexity
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
verdict.notes: The file is part of the open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) project, a well-known Japanese medical billing system. Comments are in Japanese encoded as Shift-JIS or EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake. The program is a screen handler for payment confirmation (S03N component). The absence of EXEC SQL/CICS is expected — ORCA uses its own MCP middleware layer. Source is clearly production-grade medical software, not a tutorial or demo.
